key_terms.كَاتِبِينَ: Scribes/Recorders (plural of Katib, describing their function)
key_terms.كِرَامًا: Illustrious/Honorable (plural of Karim, describing the angels)

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'illustrious scribes' mentioned in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah al-Infitar underscores the dignity of the Kiraman Katibin, who are viewed not merely as passive recorders but as honored witnesses to human agency. Their presence highlights the divine justice that ensures every deed, whether good or bad, is meticulously preserved for the final accounting on the Day of Resurrection.
